Vendored from https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator (js/dist, v2.0.4, commit 83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8), MIT.
Used only to draw the authenticator enrollment QR code in the browser (no network, no secrets stored).
The npm registry is not reachable from the build environment that added it; it is a single dependency-free file.
